APIRef_tm_wom_endpoint-discovery
mgmt/tm/wom/endpoint-discovery
/tm/wom
Configure automatic discovery of remote endpoints

OPTIONS,

Properties
Name
Type
Default Value
Required
Access
Description
autoSave
string
enabled
optional
read/write
Specifies whether the system automatically saves remote endpoints that it discovers.
description
string
optional
read/write
User defined description.
discoverable
string
enabled
optional
read/write
Specifies whether the WAN Optimization Manager responds to probe messages it receives from WAN Optimization Managers on remote BIG-IP systems.
discoveredEndpoint
string
enabled
optional
read/write
Specifies whether the WAN Optimization Manager sends out probe messages to discover other WAN Optimization Managers on remote BIG-IP systems in the network.
icmpMaxRequests
integer
1024
optional
read/write
Specifies the maximum number of ICMP probe message requests, after which the system stops sending probe message requests until at least one message is cleared from the queue by either a timeout or a response.
icmpMinBackoff
integer
5
optional
read/write
Specifies the maximum number of seconds to wait before abandoning an ICMP probe message request and resending it.
icmpNumRetries
integer
10
optional
read/write
Specifies the maximum number of times the system sends an ICMP probe message request for a single flow.
maxEndpointCount
integer
0
optional
read/write
Specifies the highest number of endpoints for the system to discover before it stops sending probe messages.
mode
string
enable-all
optional
read/write
Specifies the type of probe messages the system should send.
